svg.aria-label: The IPv4 address space as a grid of 256 blocks, coloured by use: private, special, multicast, reserved and public
svg.text: Every IPv4 address there is: 256 squares of 16.7 million each (a “/8”)
public: handed out to the world
10: all of it is private (a whole /8!)
192.168 are private; the rest is public

figure.figcaption: The whole IPv4 internet on one page. Every public square has been handed out.
